body:
Implement the Cursor native review's plugin-distribution wave: Cursor now has a first-class plugin marketplace (.cursor-plugin/plugin.json, repo marketplace.json, cursor.com/marketplace). ADR-0006's premise that Cursor has no marketplace is obsolete. Bring plugins/adlc-cursor up to that model so install is plugin install + adlc init (runtime only), not npx @adlc/cursor . copying hooks/rules/commands into every consumer repo.

=== CONTRACT (write then gate) ===
Author .adlc/specs/cursor-marketplace-plugin.md as the binding P1 spec before coding. It must pin: plugin layout, install UX, backward-compat for the npm scaffolder, hook path model, which Wave-1 hygiene items ship in-scope, and explicit out-of-scope (live deny-proof against a real Cursor binary remains advisory/GA follow-on; submitting to cursor.com/marketplace/publish is documented but the human submit step is out of band).

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. **Cursor plugin manifest.** Add plugins/adlc-cursor/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json per Cursor's plugin reference (name, description, version lockstep with package.json, author, homepage → docs/integrations/cursor.md, keywords). Point or discover: rules/, commands/ (or commands renamed from command/), hooks/, skills/, agents/ as applicable.
2. **Repo marketplace.** Add root .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json listing adlc-cursor with source ./plugins/adlc-cursor (mirror .claude-plugin/marketplace.json + .agents/plugins/marketplace.json patterns).
3. **Relative hook wiring.** Stop writing absolute PLUGIN_ROOT paths into consumer .cursor/hooks.json as the primary install path. Plugin hooks/hooks.json (or hooks.json under the discovered hooks path) must use relative commands (./hooks/adlc-pretool.mjs style) that resolve from the plugin root. Scaffold path (if retained) may still merge into a project .cursor/hooks.json for local/dev, but must prefer project-relative paths under node_modules/@adlc/cursor or document that marketplace install supersedes scaffolding hooks.
4. **Enable documented hook events.** stop and beforeSubmitPrompt are now in Cursor docs — wire them by default (remove --wire-unpinned as the only path; keep an explicit disable flag if needed). Update ADR-0006 pins.
5. **Skills (+ thin agents if cheap).** Add .cursor/skills (or plugin skills/) for phase routing + init at minimum (adlc, adlc-init), adapted from Claude Code / Codex skill bodies without inventing Cursor-only lifecycle claims. Optional in this ticket: prosecutor agent stubs that improve P5 independence; if deferred, the spec must say so and keep sequential /adlc-prosecute with the existing independence caveat.
6. **adlc init --cursor (or harness detection).** Extend packages/init so `adlc init` can bootstrap .adlc/ for Cursor without requiring npx @adlc/cursor for runtime state. Cursor plugin surfaces come from the marketplace plugin; init only writes .adlc/ + hygiene (gitignore/formatter ignores). Preserve Codex agents behavior (existing default).
7. **Truth sweep.** Update docs/integrations/cursor.md, apps/docs cursor page, apps/docs/lib/integration-facts.mjs, ADR-0006 (marketplace premise + hook pins), plugins/adlc-cursor/README.md. Remove/qualify "Cursor has no plugin marketplace". Document: install plugin from marketplace (git/local) → npm i -g @adlc/cli → adlc init → CI rails-guard. Keep npx @adlc/cursor as a documented legacy/dev fallback if still useful.
8. **Smoke + packaging.** Extend scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs to assert plugin.json, marketplace entry, relative hook commands, skills presence, and that stop/beforeSubmitPrompt are wired by default. Packaging tests assert the published/plugin surface includes the new files.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: plugins/adlc-cursor/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json validates against Cursor's required fields; version matches plugins/adlc-cursor/package.json. VERIFY: node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs (extend).
- AC2: root .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json lists adlc-cursor with source ./plugins/adlc-cursor. VERIFY: smoke + a small scripts/test or packaging assertion.
- AC3: default hook config uses relative (non-absolute) command paths; stop + beforeSubmitPrompt wired by default. VERIFY: unit tests on mergeHooks/scaffold + cursor-install-smoke.
- AC4: at least adlc + adlc-init skills ship under the plugin skills tree and are referenced by the manifest or folder discovery. VERIFY: smoke asserts SKILL.md + frontmatter name/description.
- AC5: `adlc init --root <tmp>` (with Cursor harness flag or documented default that does not break Codex) creates .adlc/ without requiring the cursor scaffolder for runtime. VERIFY: packages/init tests + cli dispatch.
- AC6: docs/integration-facts claim marketplace/plugin install (not only npx scaffold); ADR-0006 no longer asserts Cursor has no marketplace. VERIFY: apps/docs/test integration facts + docs phrase guards in smoke or docs tests.
- AC7: `node scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs .` and `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/*.test.mjs` pass; `adlc rails-guard --base main --ticket T47` passes when enforcement applies.

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- Live deny-proof against a real Cursor binary (still the GA honesty gate; document only).
- Actually clicking submit on cursor.com/marketplace/publish (document the checklist).
- Full five-lens fresh-context prosecutor agent fan-out (optional stretch; sequential prosecute may remain).
- Porting Codex MCP server (follow-on).
- Breaking removal of @adlc/cursor npm package in this ticket (may remain as fallback).

edges.contract: T47 owns Cursor marketplace install truth; T45 remains the all-harness docs sweep — do not steal T45's cross-harness scope
Mirror Codex flush patterns (init, marketplace, smoke) without coupling releases; Cursor plugin layout differs (.cursor-plugin vs .codex-plugin)

title: Ship Cursor native ADLC as a .cursor-plugin marketplace plugin (replace npm scaffold-as-install)
